title: lo que, necesitar que, faltar / hace falta que, preferir que

examples.en: I don't want you to talk about what we talked about.
examples.es: No quiero que hables sobre lo que hablamos.

cards.title: Remove ambiguity
cards.body: Hablamos can be present or past. Add el otro día, or use the line past.

examples.en: … about what we were talking about.
examples.es: No quiero que hables sobre lo que hablábamos.

cards.title: necesitar que + mood tense
cards.body: Like quiero que: a verb expressing what you want to happen, then que, then the mood tense.

examples.en: I need you (formal) to prepare it.

cards.title: faltar = to be missing / lacking
cards.body: La falta = lack: falta de respeto (lack of respect).

examples.en: I need you to prepare what's missing.
examples.es: Necesito que prepare lo que falta.

cards.title: hace falta que = it's necessary that
cards.body: Literally 'it makes lack'. A fixed, very common expression followed by the mood tense. Pronto = soon (in Italian it means 'ready').

cards.title: preferir que + mood tense
cards.body: Focus on the feeling of the mood tense, not only the structures.

examples.en: I'd prefer them not to stay here.
examples.es: Prefiero que no se queden aquí.

examples.en: I'd prefer you to give it to her.
examples.es: Prefiero que se lo des a ella.
